title: Gold Rate Today July 30: Check latest Gold prices in Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Chennai Delhi, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Kolkata & Other Cities - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
Gold prices in India rose today across all cities. The price for 8 grams of 24-carat gold also increased in all cities compared to yesterday. Below is a detailed breakdown of gold prices in key cities.

Gold prices in Indiatoday were ₹13,280 for 1 gram of 22-carat gold (up by ₹15) and ₹1,06,240 for 8 grams of 22-carat gold (up by ₹120).
